votes.headline: Consider the permanent removal of the CareerSource Polk Executive Director for cause.
votes.officialTitle: Consider the permanent removal of the CareerSource Polk Executive Director for cause.
votes.motion: Motion: 1.) That the Board finds cause pursuant to Section 445.007, Florida Statutes to remove the executive director of CareerSource Polk, Stacy Campbell-Domineck, such cause to include without limitation, neglect of duty, gross mismanagement and lack of performance; and 2:) direct staff to provide Ms. Campbell-Domineck notice of the Board's findings and give her until September 28, 2026, to provide a response to CareerSource Florida's notice and the Compliance and Governance Assessment and why cause does not exist to have her permanently removed; and 3:) place on the October 6, 2026, agenda an item for the Board to consider the permanent removal of Stacy-Campbell Domineck as the executive director of CareerSource Polk; and 4.) Stacy-Campbell Domineck's temporary removal as the executive director of CareerSource Polk shall continue until the temporary removal is terminated by this Board by way of reinstatement or permanent removal by this Board.
